sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
- The text on the box reads патроны пистолетные спортивные (patrony pistoletnyye sportivnyye, or "Sporting Pistol cartridges"), Сделано в России (Sdelano v Rossia, "Made in Russia"), and 16 Штук (16 Shtuk, "16 Pieces").
- The model for this in-game is incorrectly labeled "9mm MAKAROV" which is 9x18mm PM.
